journey.name: contact payment sharing stays disabled
journey.description: Verifies private contact payments stay off when leaving and returning to Settings. Requires an authenticated disposable Pubky identity with private contact payments enabled and a saved, linked contact. Cleanup failure injection is a manual check because network and storage fault injection are not journey capabilities, as documented in README.md. Use only one active install of this wallet.

actions.action: Open the menu and tap Settings (id "DrawerSettings")
Scroll to the payment sharing settings
Verify the private contact payments toggle (id "PrivateContactPaymentsToggle") is on
Tap the private contact payments toggle (id "PrivateContactPaymentsToggle")
Wait for the update to finish and verify the private contact payments toggle is off
Return to the wallet home screen
Open the menu and tap Settings (id "DrawerSettings")
Scroll to the payment sharing settings
Verify the private contact payments toggle (id "PrivateContactPaymentsToggle") is still off
